limits: Dimensions use cubic extrema and section roots, not landmark distances.
Join checks require matching first derivatives, not curvature continuity.
Monotone x control polygons prevent width overshoot between neighbouring landmarks.
Monotone, opposite-half-plane curves certify this construction's simple outline.
Additional intersection test uses 32 chords per curve; it is not an exact general curve test.
This top silhouette says nothing about bottom geometry, toe clearance, or shoe fit.
0.1 mm and 0.001 degree tolerances are software checks, not fit allowances.
Arc bounds use recursive chord/control-polygon bounds; total gap <=0.01 mm, depth limit 30.
Strict forward curves and closed internal joins form an open graph without self-crossings.
C1 means matching dz/dy, not matching local-parameter derivative magnitudes or curvature.
Shared top length is provisional alignment, not a validated spatial correspondence.
No 3D bottom, sole, posture transformation, toe-clearance or fit prediction.
Contour stations and regional arc preservation are our prototype assumptions, not vendor or anatomical rules.
Actual cubic chord/control-polygon bounds, not formula targets, validate arc lengths.
Projected model dimensions remain projected; no 3D last, fit or validated heel-posture claim.
